Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-01.htm.text: Master Gideon: Hello there, have you come to learn how to enhance the abilities of your weapon?

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-03.htm.text: Master Gideon: You must hurry and collect the souls of evil creatures in the soul crystal. You will find the evil ones in the northern part of Oren, the Forest of Mirrors, the Cave of Giants, the Devastated Castle, the higher reaches of the Tower of Insolence, deep within the Lair of Antharas, Eva'…

links.text: Ask about the evil creatures from which you will collect souls.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-21.htm.text: Master Gideon: How is your mission going? Oh, I see that you need a new crystal!

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-02.htm.text: Master Gideon: I have a growing sense of dread of late. Something terrible is coming. Can you hear it? The trees in the forest, the birds in the sky and the fish in the ocean...They know of what I speak... I fear for the survival of the whole Human race, but I don't know what threatens it! This dar…

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-04.htm.text: Master Gideon: Oh, marvelous! If we all develop our strengths and work together, we will triumph over the coming cataclysm. My colleagues and I have recently developed a method of enhancing weaponry that should prove quite useful to all of us. This weapons enhancement boosts strength noticeably in …

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-05.htm.text: Master Gideon: To enhance a weapon you will need some magical souls. You must collect the souls of evil creatures and trap them in the soul crystal I will give you. You will then take the crystal to a blacksmith and he will extract the magic from the crystal and apply it to a weapon for you. All bl…

links.text: "How do I collect the souls of the evil ones?"

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-06.htm.text: Master Gideon: After you have sapped the evil one's strength in battle, apply the crystal to his skin. His soul will be absorbed into the crystal. His mortal body is easily dispatched. Each soul crystal can contain up to 10 souls. A more precise explanation would be that it can contain up to 10 sou…

links.text: What are the precautions to take when collecting souls?"

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-07.htm.text: Master Gideon: The collection of a soul doesn't always go as planned. Some evil souls will simply not be absorbed, and, if you happen to collect the wrong soul, the crystal will shatter... Soul crystals develop refined tastes, and will reject weaker souls after a while. When this happens you must s…

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-08.htm.text: Master Gideon: Please choose one of the following three types of crystals: Each crystal bestows a different power upon the weapon it enhances, and the powers may vary from weapon to weapon.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-09.htm.text: Master Gideon: Here is a red soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-10.htm.text: Master Gideon: Here is a green soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30194-11.htm.text: Master Gideon: Here is a blue soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30194-note.text: Magister Gideon: Get out of my way! I teach only Dark Elven Mystics. Heed my words: if you keep annoying me, I'll teach you a lesson you'll never forget!

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30194.html.text: Magister Gideon: For all my travels and experiences, there is still one thing I cannot understand. Why does even the mention of Dark Magic send Humans into such an uproar? They have no trouble killing each other with sword and spear, so scruples about plotting and scheming... You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
